mapper.select: SELECT id, order_id, sku_id, sku_code, sku_name, expect_qty, received_qty, putaway_qty, batch_no, production_date, expiry_date, remark, deleted, create_time, update_time, create_by, update_by FROM inbound_order_item WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE inbound_order_item SET received_qty = received_qty + #{receivedQty}, batch_no = COALESCE(#{batchNo}, batch_no), production_date = COALESCE(#{productionDate}, production_date), expiry_date = COALESCE(#{expiryDate}, expiry_date) WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND received_qty + #{receivedQty} <= expect_qty
